main_conclusion: General K2 plus a left QSD does not identify the complete finite-window survival-conditioned path with a homogeneous positive-right Doob path; even simultaneous strictly positive left/right data do not imply it.

concrete_source.policy: Fixed PMF.pure unit action at every history
concrete_source.killed_matrix: Literal safe restriction of this actual source kernel
concrete_source.survival_event: Initial state and all subsequent states through T are safe
concrete_source.BiEigenData_adaptation: Use h/2=(3/2,1/2) to satisfy pairing_sum_one; the Doob kernel is unchanged.

one_step_findings.actual_conditional_path_matrix: Exactly Q as a joint probability table, not Q as a stochastic row kernel.
one_step_findings.any_Doob_initial_law_insufficient: Every probability initial row multiplied by this R has terminal (3/4,1/4), which differs from the actual conditional terminal r.

general_mathematical_formulas.source: Fixed actual finite model and the same stationary current-observation policy; arbitrary actual p0; eta0 is its unnormalized safe restriction.
general_mathematical_formulas.actual_survival: s_T=eta0 H_T; require s_T>0 for the conditional path PMF.
general_mathematical_formulas.prefix_joint: P(actual prefix x_0...x_t and S_T)=eta0(x_0)*product_(k<t) Q(x_k,x_(k+1))*H_(T-t)(x_t).
general_mathematical_formulas.conditional_row: For m=T-t>=1 and positive conditional prefix ending at i: Q_ij*H_(m-1)(j)/H_m(i).
general_mathematical_formulas.Doob_path: For positive right eigenvector h, rho>0 and c=<eta0,h>>0, initial eta0^h=eta0*h/c yields D_T=eta0*product Q*h(x_T)/(rho^T*c).
general_mathematical_formulas.exact_fixed_T_tilted_initial_equality_co: D_T=C_T iff h(X_T)=rho^T*c/s_T almost surely under the actual C_T.
general_mathematical_formulas.exact_row_equality_condition: On a positive conditional prefix and each edge Q_ij>0: H_(m-1)(j)/h(j)=H_m(i)/(rho*h(i)); actual conditional initial law must also match.
general_mathematical_formulas.constant_hazard_sufficient: If Q1=rho1 and rho>0, choose h=1; H_m=rho^m1, all conditional state rows are Q/rho, and initial is eta0/p0(K).
general_mathematical_formulas.not_universal_necessity: Restricted reachable support or sparse kernels can have other equality cases; global constant hazard is not asserted necessary without additional support conditions.
general_mathematical_formulas.strictly_positive_Q_case: For positive horizon, nonzero actual safe initial mass and all Q entries positive, conditional terminal support is all K. Equality with the naturally tilted Doob law forces h constant on K.

mathematical_derivation_scope.prefix_formula_from_actual_pmfExtend_cau: Proof route given, not made a new assumption; no new Lean implementation claimed.
mathematical_derivation_scope.finite_product_telescoping: Mathematically derived for finite paths, not a new Lean endpoint.
mathematical_derivation_scope.longer_counterexample_windows: Q^2=rho Q implies all pre-final transition rows equal Doob R, but the final row is r. Exact T=1,2,3 calculations supplement the all-T written derivation.

boundaries: s_T>0 does not make every H_m(i)>0; formula interpreted only on positive conditional prefixes/positive denominator rows.
No 0/0 row is treated as a PMF; any whole-state fallback must be explicit and irrelevant on conditional null rows.
T=0 has survival p0(K), conditional initial safe restriction normalized if positive, and no transition.
Empty K or initially zero safe mass gives no conditional experiment.
QSD rho=0 allows conditioning at T=0 but not positive T.
Conditioning typically changes the action marginal; same conditional state kernel does not identify original unconditioned policy.
Only an actual stationary feedback identity justifies a microstate Markov kernel; general history policy is not automatically Markovized.
QSD initial law cannot replace an independently fixed real initial law for convenience.
Distinct horizons use distinct conditioning events; their conditioned path laws need not form a projectively consistent family.
